newsitem.title: HUNGARY: Handgrenade attack on home of Budapest businessman.
newsitem.headline: Handgrenade attack on home of Budapest businessman.

text.p: A hand grenade was thrown into the garden a Hungarian businessman early on Friday in the latest of a spate of bomb attacks in Budapest, city police said.

They said three people had been arrested but it was unclear if the attack was directly linked to a string of twelve bombings and five armed attacks since September, believed to be part of a struggle between organised crime gangs.
A police spokesman, who declined to identify the businessman, said no-one was injured in the explosion and there was only minor damage.
One man has been killed in the recent spate of shootings and two more severely injured. The blasts have caused serious damage.
